TEDDY – Urørt-vinneren, trailblazer og årets hotteste rapper

Teddy (de/ham) er en kompromissløs artist, rapper og MC fra Bergen. Med røtter i klubb- og ballroomscenen har Teddy allerede satt et tydelig preg på kunstmiljøet i Norge.

Inspirert av den ikoniske energien fra 80-tallets punkscene, fra New York til London, beveger Teddy seg sømløst mellom rap, performance og klubbkultur.

UBACHIIII

Ubachiiii is an Oslo-based DJ who delivers energetic, uncompromising club music. Known for her razor-sharp selections and deep-dive discoveries, she blends Jersey club, hip-hop, and infectious electronic music into fast-paced, bass-driven sets designed to ignite the dance floor.

When strangers begin to move in sync, when someone hears a track they’ve never encountered before and you can see it just *click* – that’s when Ubachiiii has achieved their goal.

BANJEE

Introducing BANJEE, a dynamic DJ known for their captivating skill to make people move.

The moniker “Banjee” itself is a fusion of “Bougie” and “ghetto,” encapsulating the individuality and style that Banjee brings to their music and persona, carrying it with pride.

Banjee brings a unique mix of uptempo riddim tunes, Vogue and Jersey beats and more to the dancefloor, creating a vibe that rarely resists.
